Rerun PCA with different filtering (≥5x, ≥15x, ≥20x coverage). How does filtering affect sample clustering? Create a comparison figure and explain it.

run_pca_filter <- function(cov_threshold) {
  
  f52 <- SRR11647652 %>% filter(coverage >= cov_threshold)
  f53 <- SRR11647653 %>% filter(coverage >= cov_threshold)
  f62 <- SRR11647662 %>% filter(coverage >= cov_threshold)
  f63 <- SRR11647663 %>% filter(coverage >= cov_threshold)
  
  m52 <- f52 %>% mutate(site = paste(chr, start, end),
                       SRR11647652 = methylation_percent)
  m53 <- f53 %>% mutate(site = paste(chr, start, end),
                       SRR11647653 = methylation_percent)
  m62 <- f62 %>% mutate(site = paste(chr, start, end),
                       SRR11647662 = methylation_percent)
  m63 <- f63 %>% mutate(site = paste(chr, start, end),
                       SRR11647663 = methylation_percent)
  
  mat <- m52 %>%
    select(site, SRR11647652) %>%
    inner_join(m53 %>% select(site, SRR11647653), by="site") %>%
    inner_join(m62 %>% select(site, SRR11647662), by="site") %>%
    inner_join(m63 %>% select(site, SRR11647663), by="site")
  
  mat <- mat %>% select(-site) %>% as.matrix()
  rownames(mat) <- m52$site[match(rownames(mat), m52$site)]
  
  mat <- mat[apply(mat, 1, var) != 0, ]
  
  pca <- prcomp(t(mat), scale. = TRUE)
  
  df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
  df$sample <- c("SRR11647652","SRR11647653","SRR11647662","SRR11647663")
  df$Type <- c("non_tumor","non_tumor","tumor","tumor")
  df$filter <- paste0("≥", cov_threshold, "x")
  
  return(df)
}
pca5  <- run_pca_filter(5)
pca15 <- run_pca_filter(15)
pca20 <- run_pca_filter(20)

all_pca <- bind_rows(pca5, pca15, pca20)
all_pca$filter <- factor(all_pca$filter, 
                         levels = c("≥5x", "≥15x", "≥20x"))

coverage_thresholds <- coverage_long %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    `>=1x`  = sum(coverage >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `>=5x`  = sum(coverage >= 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    `>=15x` = sum(coverage >= 15, na.rm = TRUE),
    `>=20x` = sum(coverage >= 20, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(">="),
    names_to = "Coverage_threshold",
    values_to = "Number_of_CpGs"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Coverage_threshold = factor(
      Coverage_threshold,
      levels = c(">=1x", ">=5x", ">=15x", ">=20x")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  coverage_thresholds,
  aes(
    x = Coverage_threshold,
    y = Number_of_CpGs,
    fill = Coverage_threshold
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_id, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(

# Task 1: Perform differentially methylated cytosine (DMC) analysis between your conditions.
# ============================================================
# Create methylation_dt and coverage_dt from your R file objects
# ============================================================
library(data.table)

# Add a shared CpG ID to each sample
SRR11647652 <- SRR11647652 %>%
  mutate(cpg_id = paste(chr, start, end, sep = "_"))

SRR11647653 <- SRR11647653 %>%
  mutate(cpg_id = paste(chr, start, end, sep = "_"))

SRR11647662 <- SRR11647662 %>%
  mutate(cpg_id = paste(chr, start, end, sep = "_"))

SRR11647663 <- SRR11647663 %>%
  mutate(cpg_id = paste(chr, start, end, sep = "_"))

# Build methylation table using methylation fraction
methylation_dt <- SRR11647652 %>%
  select(cpg_id, chr, position = start, SRR11647652 = methylation_fraction) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647653 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647653 = methylation_fraction),
    by = "cpg_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647662 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647662 = methylation_fraction),
    by = "cpg_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647663 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647663 = methylation_fraction),
    by = "cpg_id"
  )

# Build coverage table using coverage
coverage_dt <- SRR11647652 %>%
  select(cpg_id, chr, position = start, SRR11647652 = coverage) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647653 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647653 = coverage),
    by = "cpg_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647662 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647662 = coverage),
    by = "cpg_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    SRR11647663 %>% select(cpg_id, SRR11647663 = coverage),
    by = "cpg_id"
  )

# Convert to data.table
setDT(methylation_dt)
setDT(coverage_dt)
# Create BSseq object
library(pacman)
sample_cols <- names(methylation_dt)[!names(methylation_dt) %in% c("cpg_id", "chr", "position")]

chr <- methylation_dt$chr
pos <- methylation_dt$position

#Create empty matrices for methylated reads and coverage
#M_matrix   = methylated read counts
#Cov_matrix = total coverage counts
M_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(methylation_dt), ncol = length(sample_cols))
Cov_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(methylation_dt), ncol = length(sample_cols))

#Fill the matrices sample by sample
  for(i in 1:length(sample_cols)) {
    sample <- sample_cols[i]
    
    meth <- methylation_dt[[sample]]
    cov <- coverage_dt[[sample]]
    
    M_matrix[, i] <- round(meth * cov, 0) #converts methylation fractions into approximate methylated-read counts.

    Cov_matrix[, i] <- cov #stores total coverage.
    
    M_matrix[is.na(M_matrix[, i]), i] <- 0
    Cov_matrix[is.na(Cov_matrix[, i]), i] <- 0  #replace missing values with 0
  }

colnames(M_matrix) <- sample_cols
colnames(Cov_matrix) <- sample_cols #This gives the matrices proper sample names.

#Create a BSseq object
library(bsseq)
BS <- BSseq(chr = chr,
            pos = pos,
            M = M_matrix,
            Cov = Cov_matrix,
            sampleNames = sample_cols)

pData(BS) <- sample_info
rownames(pData(BS)) <- sample_info$sample_id
saveRDS(BS, "bsseq_object.RDS")

# Define comparison
group1_samples <- c("SRR11647652", "SRR11647653")  # healthy / normal
group2_samples <- c("SRR11647662", "SRR11647663")  # tumor

selected_samples <- c(group1_samples, group2_samples)

# Check that samples are present
selected_samples %in% sampleNames(BS)
[1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE
# Filtering BS data. What can happen if we skip this? 
#Filter low-coverage CpGs
cov_matrix <- getCoverage(BS)
samples_covered <- rowSums(
  cov_matrix[, selected_samples] >= 10,
  na.rm = TRUE
) #For every CpG, this counts how many selected samples have coverage at least 10

keep_cpgs <- samples_covered >= 2 #keeps CpGs where at least 2 samples have coverage >= 10

BS_filtered <- BS[keep_cpgs] #subsets the BSseq object to only those CpGs.
saveRDS(BS_filtered, "BS_filtered.RDS")

library(DSS)
# Run DMC testing with DSS
# This runs differential methylation testing at individual CpG sites.
# DMLtest() compares methylation between groups
dmlTest <- DMLtest(BS_filtered, 
                  group1 = group1_samples,
                  group2 = group2_samples,
                  ncores = 1, 
                  smoothing = FALSE) #means DSS tests each CpG without smoothing methylation values across neighboring CpGs.

library(data.table)

# Convert DSS result to data.table
dml_dt <- as.data.table(dmlTest)


# -------------------------------
# Task 2: Save two lists of DMCs
# -------------------------------

# Case 1: only statistical significance
# Adjusted p-value / FDR threshold only
# It does not require the methylation difference to be large.
dmcs_fdr_only <- dml_dt[
  fdr < 0.05
]

# Case 2: statistical significance + methylation difference threshold
# FDR < 0.05 and methylation difference at least 10 percentage points
dmcs_fdr_delta <- dml_dt[
  fdr < 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.10
]

# Save both DMC lists
fwrite(dmcs_fdr_only, "DMCs_FDR_0.05_only.csv")
fwrite(dmcs_fdr_delta, "DMCs_FDR_0.05_delta_0.10.csv")


# -----------------------------------------------
# Task 3: Report total number of DMCs in both cases
# -----------------------------------------------

# Because group1 = healthy and group2 = tumor:
# diff = healthy - tumor
#
# Therefore:
# diff < 0 = hypermethylated in tumor
# diff > 0 = hypomethylated in tumor

dmc_summary <- data.frame(
  Case = c(
    "FDR < 0.05 only",
    "FDR < 0.05 and |diff| >= 0.10"
  ),
  Total_DMCs = c(
    nrow(dmcs_fdr_only),
    nrow(dmcs_fdr_delta)
  ),
  Tumor_hypermethylated = c(
    sum(dmcs_fdr_only$diff < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(dmcs_fdr_delta$diff < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  Tumor_hypomethylated = c(
    sum(dmcs_fdr_only$diff > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(dmcs_fdr_delta$diff > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

Using a chromosome you like (or several), perform DMC calling using an R package you like (you can use DSS that we used) and using the Wilcoxon test. Create Venn diagram of overlap between the methods. Table comparing the number of DMCs, mean effect size. Which method is more conservative? Why?

library(data.table)
library(matrixTests)
library(ggvenn)
library(knitr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Groups from your data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
non_tumour_samples <- c("SRR11647652", "SRR11647653")
tumour_samples     <- c("SRR11647662", "SRR11647663")

# Your methylation_dt columns are:
# cpg_id, chr, position, SRR11647652, SRR11647653, SRR11647662, SRR11647663
sample_cols <- c(non_tumour_samples, tumour_samples)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Use the same CpGs as DSS filtering
# keep_cpgs was created before DSS:
# keep_cpgs <- samples_covered >= 2
# ------------------------------------------------------------
meth_filtered <- methylation_dt[keep_cpgs, ]

# Methylation matrix for Wilcoxon
meth_wilcox <- as.matrix(meth_filtered[, ..sample_cols])
rownames(meth_wilcox) <- meth_filtered$cpg_id
mode(meth_wilcox) <- "numeric"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Wilcoxon test
# ------------------------------------------------------------
wilcox_test <- row_wilcoxon_twosample(
  meth_wilcox[, tumour_samples, drop = FALSE],
  meth_wilcox[, non_tumour_samples, drop = FALSE]
)

wilcox_results <- data.table(
  cpg_id = meth_filtered$cpg_id,
  chr = meth_filtered$chr,
  position = meth_filtered$position,
  
  # Difference is tumor - non-tumor
  # diff > 0 = hypermethylated in tumor
  # diff < 0 = hypomethylated in tumor
  diff = rowMeans(meth_wilcox[, tumour_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) -
         rowMeans(meth_wilcox[, non_tumour_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
  
  pval = wilcox_test$pvalue
)

wilcox_results[, fdr := p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")]

wilcox_dmcs <- wilcox_results[
  fdr < 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.10
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DSS DMCs
# ------------------------------------------------------------
dss_dt <- as.data.table(dmlTest)

# DSS output has columns chr and pos.
# Your methylation_dt cpg_id format is chr_start_end,
# but DSS only stores chr and pos.
# So for overlap, use chr:position in BOTH methods.
dss_dt[, cpg_id := paste0(chr, ":", pos)]

dss_dmcs <- dss_dt[
  fdr < 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.10
]

# Convert Wilcoxon cpg_id to same format as DSS
wilcox_results[, cpg_id := paste0(chr, ":", position)]

wilcox_dmcs <- wilcox_results[
  fdr < 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.10
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Venn diagram
# ------------------------------------------------------------
venn_list <- list(
  DSS = dss_dmcs$cpg_id,
  Wilcoxon = wilcox_dmcs$cpg_id
)

ggvenn(
  venn_list,
  fill_color = c("#2C7FB8", "#E64B35"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 5,
  text_size = 5
) +
  labs(
    title = "Overlap of DMCs detected by DSS and Wilcoxon test",
    subtitle = "chr20, FDR < 0.05 and |methylation difference| >= 0.10"
  )
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Table: number of DMCs and mean effect size
# ------------------------------------------------------------
overlap_ids <- intersect(dss_dmcs$cpg_id, wilcox_dmcs$cpg_id)

dmc_method_table <- data.frame(
  Method = c("DSS", "Wilcoxon", "Overlap"),
  Number_of_DMCs = c(
    nrow(dss_dmcs),
    nrow(wilcox_dmcs),
    length(overlap_ids)
  ),
  Mean_abs_effect_size = c(
    mean(abs(dss_dmcs$diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(abs(wilcox_dmcs$diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    NA
  )
)

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

# Convert DSS result to data.table
dss_dt <- as.data.table(dmlTest)

# Threshold combinations using FDR-adjusted p-value
threshold_results <- data.frame(
  Threshold = c(
    "FDR < 0.05, |Δβ| ≥ 0.10",
    "FDR < 0.01, |Δβ| ≥ 0.10",
    "FDR < 0.05, |Δβ| ≥ 0.20",
    "FDR < 0.01, |Δβ| ≥ 0.20"
  ),
  DMC_count = c(
    nrow(dss_dt[fdr < 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.10]),
    nrow(dss_dt[fdr < 0.01 & abs(diff) >= 0.10]),
    nrow(dss_dt[fdr < 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.20]),
    nrow(dss_dt[fdr < 0.01 & abs(diff) >= 0.20])
  ),
  Mean_abs_effect_size = c(
    mean(abs(dss_dt[fdr < 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.10]$diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(abs(dss_dt[fdr < 0.01 & abs(diff) >= 0.10]$diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(abs(dss_dt[fdr < 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.20]$diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(abs(dss_dt[fdr < 0.01 & abs(diff) >= 0.20]$diff), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

# Keep threshold order
threshold_results$Threshold <- factor(
  threshold_results$Threshold,
  levels = threshold_results$Threshold
)

Create a volcano plot for DMCs.  Explain the relationship between methylation difference and statistical significance.

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DSS results from your data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dss_dt <- as.data.table(dmlTest)

# Remove rows with missing p-values or FDR values
dss_dt <- dss_dt[
  !is.na(pval) & !is.na(fdr) & !is.na(diff)
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Direction of methylation difference
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DSS diff is usually group1 - group2.
# In your DSS setup:
# group1 = non-tumour / healthy
# group2 = tumour
#
# Therefore:
# diff > 0 means higher methylation in non-tumour
# diff < 0 means higher methylation in tumour
#
# Flip diff so positive = higher methylation in tumour.

dss_dt[, tumour_diff := -diff]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Define DMC status using FDR
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dss_dt[, status := fifelse(
  fdr < 0.01 & tumour_diff >= 0.20,
  "Hypermethylated in tumour",
  fifelse(
    fdr < 0.01 & tumour_diff <= -0.20,
    "Hypomethylated in tumour",
    "Not significant"
  )
)]

# Set order for legend
dss_dt[, status := factor(
  status,
  levels = c(
    "Hypermethylated in tumour",
    "Hypomethylated in tumour",
    "Not significant"
  )
)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Volcano plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  dss_dt,
  aes(
    x = tumour_diff,
    y = -log10(fdr),
    color = status
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-0.2, 0.2),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.01),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Hypermethylated in tumour" = "#E64B35",
      "Hypomethylated in tumour" = "#2C7FB8",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot of Differentially Methylated CpGs (Chromosome 20)",
    subtitle = "FDR < 0.01 and |Δβ| > 0.2 threshold shown as dashed lines",
    x = "Methylation difference in tumour (Δβ)",
    y = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
    color = "DMC status"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

Create an MA plot (or equivalent):

  • x-axis: average methylation level,
  • y-axis: methylation difference.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MA plot data from DSS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Direction of methylation difference
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DSS diff = group1 - group2
# In your analysis:
# group1 = non-tumour / healthy
# group2 = tumour
#
# Therefore:
# diff > 0 means higher methylation in non-tumour
# diff < 0 means higher methylation in tumour

# Average methylation across non-tumour and tumour groups
dss_dt[, mean_methylation := (mu1 + mu2) / 2]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Define DMC status
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dss_dt[, status := fifelse(
  fdr < 0.01 & tumour_diff >= 0.2,
  "Hypermethylated in tumour",
  fifelse(
    fdr < 0.01 & tumour_diff <= -0.2,
    "Hypomethylated in tumour",
    "Not significant"
  )
)]

dss_dt[, status := factor(
  status,
  levels = c(
    "Hypermethylated in tumour",
    "Hypomethylated in tumour",
    "Not significant"
  )
)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MA plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  dss_dt,
  aes(
    x = mean_methylation,
    y = tumour_diff,
    color = status
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(-0.2, 0.2),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Hypermethylated in tumour" = "#E64B35",
      "Hypomethylated in tumour" = "#2C7FB8",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MA Plot of Differ ential Methylation (Chromosome 20)",
    subtitle = "|Δβ| > 0.2 threshold shown as dashed line",
    x = "Average methylation level",
    y = "Methylation difference in tumour (Δβ)",
    color = "DMC status"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

library(knitr)
library(scales)

library(annotatr)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)

Įkeliamas reikalingas paketas: AnnotationDbi

Pridedamas paketas: 'AnnotationDbi'
Šis objektas yra užmaskuotas nuo 'package:dplyr':

    select
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare DSS results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dss_dt <- as.data.table(dmlTest)

dss_dt <- dss_dt %>% filter( fdr < 0.01, abs(diff) >= 0.20 )

dss_dt <- dss_dt[
  !is.na(pval) &
    !is.na(fdr) &
    !is.na(diff) &
    !is.na(chr) &
    !is.na(pos)
]

# DSS diff = group1 - group2
# group1 = non-tumour / healthy
# group2 = tumour
# Flip diff so positive = higher methylation in tumour

dss_dt[, tumour_diff := -diff]

dmcs_dt <- dss_dt[
  fdr < 0.01 & abs(tumour_diff) >= 0.20
]

dmcs_dt[, dmc_index := .I]
dmcs_dt[, cpg_id := paste0(chr, ":", pos)]

dmcs_dt[, direction := fifelse(
  tumour_diff > 0,
  "Hypermethylated in tumour",
  "Hypomethylated in tumour"
)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Convert DMCs to GRanges
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = dmcs_dt$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = dmcs_dt$pos,
    width = 1
  ),
  dmc_index = dmcs_dt$dmc_index,
  cpg_id = dmcs_dt$cpg_id,
  diff = dmcs_dt$diff,
  tumour_diff = dmcs_dt$tumour_diff,
  pval = dmcs_dt$pval,
  fdr = dmcs_dt$fdr
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build hg38 annotations directly, no RDS files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

annots <- c(
  "hg38_cpgs",
  "hg38_genes_promoters",
  "hg38_genes_5UTRs",
  "hg38_genes_exons",
  "hg38_genes_introns",
  "hg38_genes_3UTRs",
  "hg38_genes_intergenic"
)

annotations <- build_annotations(
  genome = "hg38",
  annotations = annots
)
'select()' returned 1:1 mapping between keys and columns
Building promoters...
Building 1to5kb upstream of TSS...
Building intergenic...
Building 5UTRs...
Building 3UTRs...
Building exons...
Building introns...
Building CpG islands...
Building CpG shores...
Building CpG shelves...
Building inter-CpG-islands...
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Annotate DMCs with genomic features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_annotated <- annotate_regions(
  regions = dmcs_gr,
  annotations = annotations,
  ignore.strand = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)
Annotating...
dmcs_annot_dt <- as.data.table(dmcs_annotated)

dmcs_annot_dt[, annot_type := annot.type]
dmcs_annot_dt[, annot_type := gsub("hg38_", "", annot_type)]
dmcs_annot_dt[, annot_type := gsub("genes_", "", annot_type)]
dmcs_annot_dt[, annot_type := gsub("cpg_", "", annot_type)]

dmcs_annot_dt[, cpg_id := paste0(seqnames, ":", start)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Keep one genomic annotation per DMC
# Priority:
# promoters > 5UTRs > exons > introns > 3UTRs > CpG annotations > intergenic
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_annot_dt[, annot_priority := fifelse(
  annot_type == "promoters", 1,
  fifelse(
    annot_type == "5UTRs", 2,
    fifelse(
      annot_type == "exons", 3,
      fifelse(
        annot_type == "introns", 4,
        fifelse(
          annot_type == "3UTRs", 5,
          fifelse(
            grepl("islands|shores|shelves|inter", annot_type), 6,
            7
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)]

setorder(dmcs_annot_dt, cpg_id, annot_priority)

dmcs_features <- dmcs_annot_dt[, .SD[1], by = cpg_id]

setnames(dmcs_features, c("seqnames", "start"), c("chr", "pos"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Get nearest gene information using hg38
# ------------------------------------------------------------

txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene

all_genes <- genes(txdb)
  2169 genes were dropped because they have exons located on both strands of
  the same reference sequence or on more than one reference sequence, so cannot
  be represented by a single genomic range.
  Use 'single.strand.genes.only=FALSE' to get all the genes in a GRangesList
  object, or use suppressMessages() to suppress this message.
all_genes <- keepSeqlevels(
  all_genes,
  "chr20",
  pruning.mode = "coarse"
)

nearest_genes <- distanceToNearest(
  dmcs_gr,
  all_genes,
  ignore.strand = TRUE
)

dmcs_nearest <- data.table(
  dmc_index = mcols(dmcs_gr)$dmc_index[queryHits(nearest_genes)],
  gene_id = names(all_genes)[subjectHits(nearest_genes)],
  distance_to_gene = mcols(nearest_genes)$distance
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Add gene symbols and gene names
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gene_symbols <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = unique(dmcs_nearest$gene_id),
  columns = c("SYMBOL", "GENENAME"),
  keytype = "ENTREZID"
)
'select()' returned 1:1 mapping between keys and columns
gene_symbols <- as.data.table(gene_symbols)
gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[!duplicated(ENTREZID)]

dmcs_nearest <- merge(
  dmcs_nearest,
  gene_symbols,
  by.x = "gene_id",
  by.y = "ENTREZID",
  all.x = TRUE
)

setnames(dmcs_nearest, "SYMBOL", "nearest_gene_symbol")
setnames(dmcs_nearest, "GENENAME", "nearest_gene_name")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Combine DSS DMCs, nearest genes, and genomic annotations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_final <- merge(
  dmcs_dt,
  dmcs_nearest,
  by = "dmc_index",
  all.x = TRUE
)

dmcs_final <- merge(
  dmcs_final,
  dmcs_features[, .(
    chr,
    pos,
    annot_type
  )],
  by = c("chr", "pos"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

dmcs_final[is.na(annot_type), annot_type := "unannotated"]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Group detailed annotations into broad genomic features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_final[, feature_group := fifelse(
  annot_type == "introns", "Introns",
  fifelse(
    annot_type == "intergenic", "Intergenic",
    fifelse(
      annot_type == "exons", "Exons",
      fifelse(
        annot_type == "promoters", "Promoters",
        fifelse(
          annot_type %in% c("5UTRs", "3UTRs"), "UTRs",
          "Other"
        )
      )
    )
  )
)]

dmcs_final[, feature_group := factor(
  feature_group,
  levels = c(
    "Introns",
    "Intergenic",
    "Exons",
    "Promoters",
    "Other",
    "UTRs"
  )
)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Reorder final columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

setcolorder(
  dmcs_final,
  c(
    "chr",
    "pos",
    "cpg_id",
    "diff",
    "tumour_diff",
    "pval",
    "fdr",
    "direction",
    "annot_type",
    "feature_group",
    "gene_id",
    "nearest_gene_symbol",
    "nearest_gene_name",
    "distance_to_gene",
    "dmc_index"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DMC enrichment in genomic features
# Correct version: background = all tested CpGs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(annotatr)
library(ggplot2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Start from ALL tested CpGs
# Do NOT filter this object before creating background
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dss_all_dt <- as.data.table(dmlTest)

dss_all_dt <- dss_all_dt[
  !is.na(chr) &
    !is.na(pos) &
    !is.na(fdr) &
    !is.na(diff)
]

# Make CpG ID
dss_all_dt[, cpg_id := paste0(chr, ":", pos)]

# Optional: if diff is control - tumour, reverse it
# If your diff is already tumour - control, remove this line
dss_all_dt[, tumour_diff := -diff]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define DMCs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_dt <- dss_all_dt[
  fdr < 0.01 & abs(tumour_diff) >= 0.2
]

dmcs_dt[, dmc_index := .I]

dmcs_dt[, direction := fifelse(
  tumour_diff > 0,
  "Hypermethylated in tumour",
  "Hypomethylated in tumour"
)]

# Quick sanity check
cat("All tested CpGs:", nrow(dss_all_dt), "\n")

# 3. Create GRanges for DMCs

dmcs_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = dmcs_dt$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = dmcs_dt$pos,
    width = 1
  ),
  cpg_id = dmcs_dt$cpg_id
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Annotate DMCs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_annotated <- annotate_regions(
  regions = dmcs_gr,
  annotations = annotations,
  ignore.strand = TRUE,
  quiet = TRUE
)

dmcs_dt_annot <- as.data.table(dmcs_annotated)

dmcs_dt_annot[, annot_type := annot.type]
dmcs_dt_annot[, annot_type := gsub("hg38_", "", annot_type)]
dmcs_dt_annot[, annot_type := gsub("genes_", "", annot_type)]
dmcs_dt_annot[, annot_type := gsub("cpg_", "", annot_type)]

dmcs_dt_annot[, cpg_id := paste0(seqnames, ":", start)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Keep one annotation per DMC using priority
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_dt_annot[, annot_priority := fifelse(
  annot_type == "promoters", 1,
  fifelse(
    annot_type == "5UTRs", 2,

      annot_type == "exons", 3,

          )

)]

setorder(dmcs_dt_annot, cpg_id, annot_priority)

# Add unannotated DMCs back if annotate_regions dropped them

enrichment_table[bg_percentage == 0, enrichment := NA_real_]

DMR calling

Identify differentially methylated regions (DMRs). Test at least 3 parameter sets (see below). Compare results (number of DMRs, length, and CpG density), choose optimal parameters set (you can use your own set if you see that it is better); and justify your decision.

  • minCG=3, minlen=50, p=0.05
  • minCG=5, minlen=100, p=0.01
  • minCG=7, minlen=200, p=0.01
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DMR calling with different parameter sets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Parameter sets required in the task
dmr_params <- data.frame(
  Parameter_set = c(
    "Set 1: minCG=3, minlen=50, p=0.05",
    "Set 2: minCG=5, minlen=100, p=0.01",
    "Set 3: minCG=7, minlen=200, p=0.01"
  ),
  minCG = c(3, 5, 7),
  minlen = c(50, 100, 200),
  p_threshold = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.01)
)

## Function to call DMRs and summarize them
run_dmr_calling <- function(minCG, minlen, p_threshold, set_name) {
  
  dmrs <- callDMR(
    dmlTest,
    p.threshold = p_threshold,
    minCG = minCG,
    minlen = minlen
  )
  
  dmrs_dt <- as.data.table(dmrs)
  
  if (nrow(dmrs_dt) == 0) {
    summary_dt <- data.table(
      Parameter_set = set_name,
      minCG = minCG,
      minlen = minlen,
      p_threshold = p_threshold,
      Number_of_DMRs = 0,
      Mean_length_bp = NA_real_,
      Median_length_bp = NA_real_,
      Mean_CpGs_per_DMR = NA_real_,
      Mean_CpG_density_per_kb = NA_real_,
      Mean_abs_methylation_difference = NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    
    # Check column names
    print(names(dmrs_dt))
    
    # DMR length
    dmrs_dt[, length_bp := end - start + 1]
    
    # CpG density
    dmrs_dt[, CpG_density_per_kb := nCG / length_bp * 1000]
    
    # DSS usually uses diff.Methy, not meanDiff
    if ("diff.Methy" %in% names(dmrs_dt)) {
      meth_diff <- as.numeric(dmrs_dt$diff.Methy)
    } else if ("meanDiff" %in% names(dmrs_dt)) {
      meth_diff <- as.numeric(dmrs_dt$meanDiff)
    } else {
      meth_diff <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dmrs_dt))
    }
    
    summary_dt <- data.table(
      Parameter_set = set_name,
      minCG = minCG,
      minlen = minlen,
      p_threshold = p_threshold,
      Number_of_DMRs = nrow(dmrs_dt),
      Mean_length_bp = mean(dmrs_dt$length_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median_length_bp = median(dmrs_dt$length_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_CpGs_per_DMR = mean(as.numeric(dmrs_dt$nCG), na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_CpG_density_per_kb = mean(dmrs_dt$CpG_density_per_kb, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_abs_methylation_difference = mean(abs(meth_diff), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
  
  list(
    dmrs = dmrs_dt,
    summary = summary_dt
  )
}

# Run all 3 parameter sets
dmr_results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(dmr_params)), function(i) {
  run_dmr_calling(
    minCG = dmr_params$minCG[i],
    minlen = dmr_params$minlen[i],
    p_threshold = dmr_params$p_threshold[i],
    set_name = dmr_params$Parameter_set[i]
  )
})

Characterize your DMRs. Show Length distribution, CpGs per DMR distribution, chromosome distribution, hyper vs hypo properties, density plot across genome, correlation between DMR length and effect size.

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Characterize selected DMRs: Set 2
# minCG = 5, minlen = 100, p = 0.01
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Select Set 2 DMRs
optimal_dmrs <- as.data.table(dmr_results[[2]]$dmrs)

optimal_dmrs <- optimal_dmrs %>%
  mutate(
    length_bp = end - start + 1,
    CpG_density_per_kb = nCG / length_bp * 1000,

    # DSS diff.Methy follows group1 - group2
    # group1 = healthy, group2 = tumour
    # so positive diff.Methy = higher methylation in healthy
    # tumour_diff flips it so positive = higher methylation in tumour
    tumour_diff = -diff.Methy,

    effect_size = tumour_diff,
    abs_effect_size = abs(tumour_diff),

    methylation_direction = ifelse(
      tumour_diff > 0,
      "Hypermethylated in tumour",
      "Hypomethylated in tumour"
    ),

    midpoint = (start + end) / 2
  )
# Summary table
dmr_characterization_summary <- optimal_dmrs %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_DMRs = n(),
    Mean_length_bp = mean(length_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_length_bp = median(length_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_CpGs_per_DMR = mean(nCG, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_CpGs_per_DMR = median(nCG, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_CpG_density_per_kb = mean(CpG_density_per_kb, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_abs_effect_size = mean(abs_effect_size, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hypermethylated_DMRs = sum(methylation_direction == "Hypermethylated in tumour"),
    Hypomethylated_DMRs = sum(methylation_direction == "Hypomethylated in tumour")
  )

Save a list of DMRs including:

  • genomic coordinates,
  • number of CpGs per region,
  • mean methylation difference,
  • statistical significance.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save final DMR list from optimal parameter set
# ------------------------------------------------------------

final_dmrs <- optimal_dmrs %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    genomic_coordinates = paste0(chr, ":", start, "-", end)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    chr,
    start,
    end,
    genomic_coordinates,
    nCG,
    diff.Methy,
    tumour_diff,
    methylation_direction,
    areaStat
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    chromosome = chr,
    region_start = start,
    region_end = end,
    number_of_CpGs = nCG,
    healthy_minus_tumour_difference = diff.Methy,
    tumour_minus_healthy_difference = tumour_diff,
    statistical_significance = areaStat
  )

write.csv(final_dmrs, "final_dmrs_list.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Compare DMCs and DMR. Calculate and plot the number/fractions of DMCs falling within DMRs; number of isolated DMRs. Calculate enrichment in promoters, CGI).

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Compare DMCs and DMRs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create significant DMC list
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DSS callDML extracts significant differentially methylated CpG sites.
# You can change p.threshold if needed, but 0.01 matches the selected DMR p-value.

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create final significant DMC list
# chosen threshold: FDR < 0.01 and |Δβ| >= 0.20
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmcs_all <- as.data.table(dmlTest)

dmcs_sig <- dmcs_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    fdr < 0.01,
    abs(diff) >= 0.20
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert DMCs and DMRs to GRanges
# ------------------------------------------------------------
library(GenomicRanges)
library(IRanges)

dmcs_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = dmcs_sig$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = dmcs_sig$pos,
    end = dmcs_sig$pos
  )
)

# Keep only columns that definitely exist (senas var)
# dmcs_gr <- GRanges(
#   seqnames = dmcs$chr,
#   ranges = IRanges(
#     start = dmcs$pos,
#     end = dmcs$pos
#   )
# )

# Add metadata only if the columns exist
if ("diff" %in% names(dmcs_sig)) {
  mcols(dmcs_gr)$diff <- dmcs_sig$diff
}

if ("pvals" %in% names(dmcs_sig)) {
  mcols(dmcs_gr)$pval <- dmcs_sig$pvals
}

if ("pval" %in% names(dmcs_sig)) {
  mcols(dmcs_gr)$pval <- dmcs_sig$pval
}

if ("qvals" %in% names(dmcs_sig)) {
  mcols(dmcs_gr)$qval <- dmcs_sig$qvals
}

if ("qval" %in% names(dmcs_sig)) {
  mcols(dmcs_gr)$qval <- dmcs_sig$qval
}

dmrs_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = optimal_dmrs$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = optimal_dmrs$start,
    end = optimal_dmrs$end
  ),
  nCG = optimal_dmrs$nCG,
  diff.Methy = optimal_dmrs$diff.Methy,
  areaStat = optimal_dmrs$areaStat
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DMCs falling within DMRs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dmc_in_dmr_hits <- findOverlaps(dmcs_gr, dmrs_gr)

number_dmcs_total <- length(dmcs_gr)
number_dmcs_in_dmrs <- length(unique(queryHits(dmc_in_dmr_hits)))
number_dmcs_outside_dmrs <- number_dmcs_total - number_dmcs_in_dmrs

fraction_dmcs_in_dmrs <- number_dmcs_in_dmrs / number_dmcs_total
fraction_dmcs_outside_dmrs <- number_dmcs_outside_dmrs / number_dmcs_total

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DMRs containing at least one DMC and isolated DMRs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

number_dmrs_total <- length(dmrs_gr)
number_dmrs_with_dmcs <- length(unique(subjectHits(dmc_in_dmr_hits)))
number_isolated_dmrs <- number_dmrs_total - number_dmrs_with_dmcs

fraction_dmrs_with_dmcs <- number_dmrs_with_dmcs / number_dmrs_total
fraction_isolated_dmrs <- number_isolated_dmrs / number_dmrs_total

comparison_summary <- data.frame(
  Category = c(
    "Total DMCs",
    "DMCs inside DMRs",
    "DMCs outside DMRs",
    "Total DMRs",
    "DMRs with at least one DMC",
    "Isolated DMRs"
  ),
  Number = c(
    number_dmcs_total,
    number_dmcs_in_dmrs,
    number_dmcs_outside_dmrs,
    number_dmrs_total,
    number_dmrs_with_dmcs,
    number_isolated_dmrs
  ),
  Fraction = c(
    NA,
    fraction_dmcs_in_dmrs,
    fraction_dmcs_outside_dmrs,
    NA,
    fraction_dmrs_with_dmcs,
    fraction_isolated_dmrs
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Simple enrichment test using all tested CpGs as background
# ------------------------------------------------------------

background_cpgs <- as.data.table(dmlTest)

background_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = background_cpgs$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = background_cpgs$pos,
    end = background_cpgs$pos
  )
)

background_annotations <- annotate_regions(
  regions = background_gr,
  annotations = annotations,
  ignore.strand = TRUE,
  quiet = TRUE
)

background_annotations_df <- as.data.frame(background_annotations)

background_annotation_summary <- background_annotations_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CpG_id = paste(seqnames, start, end, sep = "_"),
    in_promoter = grepl("promoter", annot.type, ignore.case = TRUE),
    in_CGI = grepl("cpg_islands", annot.type, ignore.case = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CpG_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    promoter_overlap = any(in_promoter),
    CGI_overlap = any(in_CGI),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Promoter enrichment
promoter_matrix <- matrix(
  c(
    number_dmrs_in_promoters,
    number_dmrs_total - number_dmrs_in_promoters,
    sum(background_annotation_summary$promoter_overlap),
    nrow(background_annotation_summary) - sum(background_annotation_summary$promoter_overlap)
  ),
  nrow = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)

promoter_enrichment <- fisher.test(promoter_matrix)

# CpG island enrichment
cgi_matrix <- matrix(
  c(
    number_dmrs_in_CGI,
    number_dmrs_total - number_dmrs_in_CGI,
    sum(background_annotation_summary$CGI_overlap),
    nrow(background_annotation_summary) - sum(background_annotation_summary$CGI_overlap)
  ),
  nrow = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)

cgi_enrichment <- fisher.test(cgi_matrix)

enrichment_results <- data.frame(
  Annotation = c("Promoters", "CpG islands"),
  Odds_ratio = c(
    promoter_enrichment$estimate,
    cgi_enrichment$estimate
  ),
  P_value = c(
    promoter_enrichment$p.value,
    cgi_enrichment$p.value
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract methylation proportions from BS object
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cov_matrix <- getCoverage(BS, type = "Cov")  # total coverage
m_matrix <- getCoverage(BS, type = "M")      # methylated counts

# Methylation proportion per CpG per sample
meth_matrix <- m_matrix / cov_matrix

# Convert to data frame
meth_percent <- as.data.frame(meth_matrix)

# Add chromosome and position information
meth_percent$chr <- as.character(seqnames(rowRanges(BS)))
meth_percent$pos <- start(rowRanges(BS))

# Create site ID
meth_percent <- meth_percent %>%
  dplyr::mutate(site_id = paste(chr, pos, sep = "_"))


# Create site IDs for top DMCs
top_dmcs <- top_dmcs %>%
  dplyr::mutate(site_id = paste(chr, pos, sep = "_"))

# Filter methylation matrix to top DMCs
top_dmc_matrix <- meth_percent %>%
  dplyr::filter(site_id %in% top_dmcs$site_id)

rownames(top_dmc_matrix) <- top_dmc_matrix$site_id

# Keep only sample methylation columns
top_dmc_matrix <- top_dmc_matrix %>%
  dplyr::select(-chr, -pos, -site_id)

top_dmc_matrix <- as.matrix(top_dmc_matrix)

# Remove rows with missing or infinite values
top_dmc_matrix <- top_dmc_matrix[complete.cases(top_dmc_matrix), ]
top_dmc_matrix <- top_dmc_matrix[apply(top_dmc_matrix, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x))), ]
pheatmap(
  top_dmc_matrix,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_col = annotation,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  main = "Heatmap of Top Significant DMCs"
)
# Select top DMRs by statistical evidence
# DSS DMR output uses areaStat; larger absolute areaStat = stronger regional signal
top_dmrs <- optimal_dmrs %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(areaStat))) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n_dmrs) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    DMR_id = paste0(chr, ":", start, "-", end)
  )

# Convert top DMRs to GRanges
top_dmrs_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = top_dmrs$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = top_dmrs$start,
    end = top_dmrs$end
  )
)

# Convert methylation CpG positions to GRanges
meth_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = meth_percent$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = meth_percent$pos,
    end = meth_percent$pos
  )
)

# Keep only sample methylation columns
meth_sample_cols <- setdiff(
  colnames(meth_percent),
  c("chr", "pos", "site_id")
)

mcols(meth_gr) <- meth_percent[, meth_sample_cols]

# Find CpGs that fall inside top DMRs
hits <- findOverlaps(meth_gr, top_dmrs_gr)

# Create overlap table
overlap_df <- data.frame(
  CpG_index = queryHits(hits),
  DMR_index = subjectHits(hits)
)

overlap_df$DMR_id <- top_dmrs$DMR_id[overlap_df$DMR_index]

# Extract methylation values
meth_values <- as.data.frame(mcols(meth_gr))
meth_values$CpG_index <- seq_len(nrow(meth_values))

# Join CpGs to DMRs
overlap_meth <- overlap_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meth_values, by = "CpG_index")

# Average methylation per DMR per sample
top_dmr_matrix <- overlap_meth %>%
  dplyr::select(-CpG_index, -DMR_index) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(DMR_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(meth_sample_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Convert to matrix
top_dmr_matrix <- as.data.frame(top_dmr_matrix)
rownames(top_dmr_matrix) <- top_dmr_matrix$DMR_id

top_dmr_matrix <- top_dmr_matrix %>%
  dplyr::select(-DMR_id)

top_dmr_matrix <- as.matrix(top_dmr_matrix)

# Remove rows with missing or infinite values
top_dmr_matrix <- top_dmr_matrix[complete.cases(top_dmr_matrix), ]
top_dmr_matrix <- top_dmr_matrix[
  apply(top_dmr_matrix, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x))),
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper function to extract gene symbols
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_gene_symbols <- function(annotation_df) {
  
  possible_gene_cols <- c(
    "annot.symbol",
    "symbol",
    "gene_name",
    "gene_symbol",
    "external_gene_name"
  )
  
  gene_col <- possible_gene_cols[possible_gene_cols %in% names(annotation_df)][1]
  
  if (is.na(gene_col)) {
    stop("No gene symbol column found. Check names(annotation_df).")
  }
  
  genes <- annotation_df[[gene_col]]
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes)]
  genes <- genes[genes != ""]
  genes <- unique(genes)
  
  return(genes)
}

library(org.Hs.eg.db)

convert_to_entrez <- function(gene_symbols) {
  
  gene_symbols <- unique(gene_symbols)
  gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[!is.na(gene_symbols)]
  gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[gene_symbols != ""]
  
  converted <- bitr(
    gene_symbols,
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
  
  unique(converted$ENTREZID)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# GO enrichment function
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_go_enrichment <- function(entrez_genes) {
  
  if (length(entrez_genes) < 5) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  enrichGO(
    gene = entrez_genes,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
    readable = TRUE
  )
}

go_all_dmr <- run_go_enrichment(all_dmr_entrez)
go_promoter_dmr <- run_go_enrichment(promoter_dmr_entrez)
go_hyper_dmc <- run_go_enrichment(hyper_dmc_entrez)
go_hypo_dmc <- run_go_enrichment(hypo_dmc_entrez)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KEGG enrichment function
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_kegg_enrichment <- function(entrez_genes) {
  
  if (length(entrez_genes) < 5) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  enrichKEGG(
    gene = entrez_genes,
    organism = "hsa",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH"
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper function: count enriched terms/pathways
# ------------------------------------------------------------

count_terms <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(0)
  }
  
  x_df <- tryCatch(
    as.data.frame(x),
    error = function(e) data.frame()
  )
  
  nrow(x_df)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper function to extract gene symbols
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_gene_symbols <- function(annotation_df) {
  
  possible_gene_cols <- c(
    "annot.symbol",
    "symbol",
    "gene_name",
    "gene_symbol",
    "external_gene_name"
  )
  
  gene_col <- possible_gene_cols[possible_gene_cols %in% names(annotation_df)][1]
  
  if (is.na(gene_col)) {
    stop("No gene symbol column found. Check names(annotation_df).")
  }
  
  genes <- annotation_df[[gene_col]]
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes)]
  genes <- genes[genes != ""]
  unique(genes)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Add methylation direction to DMCs
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DSS diff = group1 - group2.
# In this analysis, positive diff means higher methylation in the healthy/non-tumour group.
# Therefore:
# diff < 0 = hypermethylated in tumour
# diff > 0 = hypomethylated in tumour

dmcs_sig <- dmcs_sig %>%
  dplyr::filter(chr == "chr20") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    DMC_id = paste(chr, pos, sep = "_"),
    methylation_direction = dplyr::case_when(
      diff < 0 ~ "Hypermethylated",
      diff > 0 ~ "Hypomethylated",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# This is the key fix:
# enrichment is tested against chr20 genes only,
# not against the whole genome.

txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene

chr20_genes_gr <- keepSeqlevels(

  "chr20",

)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs and keep chr20 genes only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

convert_to_entrez_chr20 <- function(gene_symbols, universe_entrez = chr20_universe_entrez) {
  
  gene_symbols <- unique(gene_symbols)
  gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[!is.na(gene_symbols)]
  gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[gene_symbols != ""]
  
  if (length(gene_symbols) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  
  converted <- bitr(
    gene_symbols,
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
  
  entrez <- unique(converted$ENTREZID)
  
  # Restrict gene list to chromosome 20 universe
  entrez <- intersect(entrez, universe_entrez)
  
  entrez
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# GO enrichment function using chromosome 20 background
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_go_enrichment_chr20 <- function(entrez_genes) {
  
  entrez_genes <- intersect(unique(entrez_genes), chr20_universe_entrez)
  
  if (length(entrez_genes) < 5) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  enrichGO(
    gene = entrez_genes,
    universe = chr20_universe_entrez,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
    readable = TRUE
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KEGG enrichment function using chromosome 20 background
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_kegg_enrichment_chr20 <- function(entrez_genes) {
  
  entrez_genes <- intersect(unique(entrez_genes), chr20_universe_entrez)
  
  if (length(entrez_genes) < 5) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  enrichKEGG(
    gene = entrez_genes,
    universe = chr20_universe_entrez,
    organism = "hsa",
    keyType = "kegg",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH"
  )
}

kegg_hypo_dmc_chr20 <- run_kegg_enrichment_chr20(hypo_dmc_entrez_chr20)

count_terms <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(0)
  }
  
  x_df <- tryCatch(
    as.data.frame(x),
    error = function(e) data.frame()
  )
  
  nrow(x_df)
}

    "Chromosome 20 hypermethylated DMC genes",
    "Chromosome 20 hypomethylated DMC genes"
  ),
  Input_genes = c(
    length(all_dmr_entrez_chr20),
    length(promoter_dmr_entrez_chr20),
    length(hyper_dmc_entrez_chr20),
    length(hypo_dmc_entrez_chr20)

  GO_terms = c(

)
